lines.say: Three, two, one... Iftar! Everyone at the table counts down!
lines.cap: Three, two, one... Iftar! Everyone at the table counts down!

lines.say: A countdown is just one step, repeated. A function calling itself. Recursion!
lines.cap: A countdown is one step, repeated. A function calling itself: recursion!

lines.say: Countdown prints n, then calls itself with n minus one!
lines.cap: countdown prints n, then calls itself with n - 1!

lines.say: Calling itself? Won't it run forever?
lines.cap: Calling itself? Won't it run FOREVER?

lines.say: Not with a base case! When n hits zero, it stops!
lines.cap: Not with a base case! When n hits 0, it stops!

lines.say: No base case? Python gives up with a recursion error!
lines.cap: No base case? Python gives up with a RecursionError!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Yes! Three plus two plus one, and the base case stops it!
lines.cap: Yes! 3 + 2 + 1, and the base case stops it!
